'''2020 MPC Sean Mackin DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sean Mackin]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sean Mackin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Mackin DS 2020 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-match-play-championships.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162034/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
